result.rationale: The diff lowercases blacklist entries (`process.env.BLACKLISTED_GUEST_EMAILS.split(",").map((email) => email.toLowerCase())`) but then compares `blacklistedGuests.includes(guest)` without lowercasing `guest`, so a guest like `Bad@Example.com` bypasses the blacklist. Similarly, the existing-attendee dedup uses exact `guest === attendee.email`, so `User@Example.com` vs `user@example.com` would be added again, creating a duplicate logical recipient. Both comparisons are visible verbatim in addGuests.handler.ts.
